thread:
sam.devex: quick heads-up — we have a reproducible mismatch coming from the embeddings/rerank flow in the sample app. Node helper batches with padding, Python SDK returns a different vector dim for the same input :thinking_face:

sam.devex: minimal repro attached below. Node send shape: batch of 3, vectors padded to 1536. Python client returns embeddings with length 1535. User sees downstream ranker crash.

sam.devex: request payload (sent from node sample app):
```json
{"inputs": ["a","b","c"], "batching": {"pad_to": 1536}}
```

sam.devex: server response (expected):
```json
{"embeddings": [[...1536 floats...], [...1536 floats...], [...1536 floats...]]}
```

maria-sdk: ugh. do you know if the node helper is trimming a trailing zero, or if python is dropping one element on decode? :eyes:

evan-ml: I saw a similar report last month — usually this is from our batching helper adding a pad token but then the client-level reshape assumes a fixed stride and slices incorrectly. Can you paste the raw binary/array length?

sam.devex: raw lengths from the two clients:
- node: 4608 floats (3 * 1536)
- python: 4605 floats (3 * 1535)
so python is returning 3 fewer floats in total, like a per-vector off-by-one.

pranav: that screams off-by-one in the embedding decoder or a header byte stripped by an auth retry wrapper. We had one bug where the retry middleware re-streamed and dropped a trailing comma in newline-delimited JSON.

maria-sdk: can we confirm if this happens only when retry kicks in? sam, did you see any 401/5xx prior to final success?

sam.devex: repro log shows: 401 preflight -> auth refresh -> retry -> success. When I force no-retry (single attempt) python returns correct dims. So it looks tied to the retry path.

jess: tagging @evan-ml and @pranav — this could be a bad interaction between sdk retry and the streaming decoder. I pushed a small test to CI: `sdk/tests/embeddings/test_retry_shape.py` — it fails consistently.

ci-bot: Build #9021 failed — sdk/tests/embeddings/test_retry_shape.py — see https://ci.redwood.ai/9021 for logs :x:

evan-ml: copying failure log snippet:
```
AssertionError: expected 1536, got 1535 at embeddings[1]
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "sdk/tests/embeddings/test_retry_shape.py", line 42, in test_retry_preserves_shape
    self.assertEqual(len(embeddings[1]), 1536)
```

pranav: OK, quick root-cause theory: retry path concatenates two chunks but misses a final byte on the boundary because one stream read returns a partial float last element, and our float unpacking expects multiples of 4/8 bytes. The node helper probably handles chunk reassembly differently.

maria-sdk: short-term workaround: add a shape-assert in the SDK and re-request on mismatch (idempotent) or fall back to server-side reconcat. But that masks the bug. We should fix binary reassembly in the retry middleware.

sam.devex: for customer-facing, I opened an issue and added a sampleapp patch that retries the entire call if embedding dims mismatch. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/298 — includes a unit that simulates auth-flap.

jess: can we add an integration test (node + python parity) to catch this in pre-merge? Also add an explicit pad-to field in response meta so clients can validate quickly.

evan-ml: Agreed. I'll put up a patch to the runtime that makes chunk boundaries explicit in the streaming protocol and add a small checksum per-embedding. That way an SDK can detect partials before decoding.

pranav: timeline? I can take the SDK fix (retry-on-dim-mismatch) and add a telemetry event when it happens. That will buy time while runtime patch rolls out.

maria-sdk: I'll open a PR with both changes: 1) shape-assert + idempotent re-request, 2) clearer logging. Also add a short note to embed onboarding docs about padding parity across SDKs.

sam.devex: thanks. I'll ping the affected customer with temporary workaround and ETA. Glhf :thumbsup:

jess: leaving a note to update release notes: "Fix: embeddings SDK retry path caused off-by-one vector length under auth retry; added parity tests and telemetry."

maria-sdk: filing PR now. cc @oncall if we see more regressions.

sam.devex: resolving for now — will follow up when PRs land.
